history.summary: Construction was initiated in 2003 by Acharya Bhrigu Giri Maharaj at Narasingha Khetra near Puranigudam, about 12 km from Nagaon town; the site is traditionally linked to Guru Shukracharya's performance of the Mahamrityunjaya mantra. After several failed designs, final engineering was done by Er. Narayan Sharma. The Pran Pratishta Mahotsav was held 22-25 February 2021 and the temple opened to devotees on 26 February 2021. The temple is built in the form of a 126-foot Shivalinga, claimed to be the world's tallest. No conflicts found; town kept as Nagaon per CSV (site is Narasingha Khetra, Puranigudam, ~12 km from Nagaon town).

name: Maha Mrityunjay Temple
town_description: Nagaon is a major town of central Assam on the Kolong river, serving as the district headquarters. It is the birthplace region of Srimanta Sankardeva (at nearby Bordowa/Batadrawa), founder of Ekasarana Vaishnavism, and a gateway to Kaziranga National Park.
